source.description:
## PROBLEM

config/specialists/node-coordinator.specialist.json has no 'prompt' block at all, so it cannot declare an output_schema. This was surfaced as a residual defect in PR #230's quarantine log and confirmed live during 2026-07-30 audit (bead unitAI-u2smm).

Verification:
  $ python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('config/specialists/node-coordinator.specialist.json')); print('has prompt:', 'prompt' in d); print('has output_schema:', d.get('prompt',{}).get('output_schema') is not None)"
  has prompt: False
  has output_schema: False

## SUCCESS

- config/specialists/node-coordinator.specialist.json declares a prompt.output_schema that matches what runtime consumers actually parse from the coordinator's structured output.
- sp validate node-coordinator passes.
- One unit or integration test asserts the schema is present and (if runtime uses it) that a canned coordinator response validates against it.

## SCOPE

Only config/specialists/node-coordinator.specialist.json plus its consuming schema (if defined elsewhere) and one test.

## NON_GOALS

- Refactoring the coordinator prompt.
- Changing runtime consumer behavior beyond adding schema validation.

## CONSTRAINTS

- Do not raise permission tier.
- Preserve existing top-level fields.

## VALIDATION

- sp validate node-coordinator
- Grep for consumers of coordinator output to confirm the schema shape.

## OUTPUT

- One edit to node-coordinator.specialist.json.
- One test file or extension of an existing suite.
source.title: BUG: node-coordinator.specialist.json lacks prompt.output_schema
